NORTHBRIDGE SYSTEMS NIGERIA LTD
EMPLOYEE BENEFIT SUMMARY
Employee: Amina Bello
Employment: Frontend Engineer
Health plan
Health coverage is employer-sponsored. Coverage remains active through the employee's last working
day and continues for 30 calendar days after employment ends. After that period, continuation is not
automatic and must be arranged separately if available.
Group life cover
Group life cover is employer-linked and ends when the employee ceases to be eligible under the
employer policy.
Pension
Retirement savings are held in the employee's personal retirement account and are not owned by the
employer.
Synthetic test document for Treviqo - not a real employment record.
